name: Symbotic Inc.
fiscal_year_note: 52/53-week fiscal year ending on the last Saturday of September. FY2025 ended Sep 27, 2025; FY2026 ended Sep 26, 2026 (Q1 to Dec 27, 2025; Q2 to Mar 28, 2026; Q3 Mar 29 to Jun 27, 2026; Q4 to Sep 26, 2026). Q4/FY2026 results are not yet reported; stockanalysis estimates Nov 23, 2026 after the close (not confirmed by the company; MarketBeat lists conflicting dates). Symbotic reports after the close and guides only one quarter ahead.
guidance: Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended Sep 26, 2026), given Aug 5, 2026: revenue $760M-$780M (+23% to +26% vs $618.5M) and adjusted EBITDA $100M-$105M. Management expected roughly flat adjusted EBITDA margin vs Q3, gross margin nearer Q2 levels, modestly higher R&D, Q4 system starts similar to or slightly below Q3, and positive free cash flow in Q4 and for FY2026. Implied FY2026: revenue about $2.79B-$2.81B (+24% to +25%) and adjusted EBITDA about $340M-$345M (9M actual $239.9M plus Q4 guide). No annual or FY2027 guidance yet.

consensus_next_fy.label: FY2027 (Sep 27, 2026 to late Sep 2027)
consensus_next_fy.eps_basis: non-GAAP adjusted per stockanalysis (17 analysts); MarketBeat shows a much lower next-year EPS consensus of about $0.35, so EPS definitions vary. FY2026 consensus: revenue $2.80B, adjusted EPS $0.57.

valuation.basis: pe_forward from stockanalysis at the Oct 26, 2026 close. EV $21.20B (stockanalysis: market cap on all economic shares minus net cash of $1.72B). ev_sales_forward = EV / FY2027 consensus revenue $3.60B. ev_ebitda_forward is an ESTIMATE (see notes); on FY2026E adjusted EBITDA of about $342M the multiple is about 62x.

physical_ai_exposure.description: Pure-play AI-enabled warehouse robotics: end-to-end automated case-handling systems (fleets of autonomous SymBot vehicles, robotic arms, high-density storage structure and orchestration software) for retail, grocery and wholesale distribution centers, plus BreakPack (break-pack order picking), SymMicro store micro-fulfillment from the Walmart ASR acquisition, warehouse-as-a-service through the Exol (formerly GreenBox) JV, and software and operations services.
physical_ai_exposure.optionality_notes: Walmart store automation: in Jan 2025 Walmart agreed to buy systems for 400 Accelerated Pickup and Delivery (APD) centers over several years (Symbotic said this could add more than $5B of backlog; it is excluded from the $22.5B backlog and store orders are not expected to affect results until early 2028), and Walmart funds a $520M development program. Exol (35% Symbotic / 65% SoftBank) committed to at least $7.5B of Symbotic systems over six years. New verticals and regions: Medline (healthcare), Southern Glazer's (2nd site signed in Q3 FY26), Walmart de Mexico; international revenue was 12% of Q3 FY26 vs 1% a year earlier. Tuck-in M&A: Fox Robotics (autonomous trailer loading/dock automation), ARMS Innovations (UK warehouse software, Jul 2026), cellumation (Bremen, celluveyor omnidirectional sortation, Oct 2026), plus an investment in battery supplier Nyobolt.

backlog_or_pipeline: Backlog (remaining performance obligations) $22.5B at Jun 27, 2026 (vs $22.7B at Mar 28, 2026 and $22.5B at Sep 27, 2025), about 8.5x LTM revenue. About 15% (about $3.4B) is expected to convert in the next 12 months and 62% in months 13-60. At FY2025 year-end GreenBox/Exol accounted for $11.6B, and Walmart plus GreenBox were the vast majority. The 10-Q cites a $5.0B Walmart range-of-outcomes amount tied to the Walmart agreements (42 regional distribution centers and 400 APD purchases); management says the ~400 store systems are excluded from backlog. Deployment status at end of Q3 FY26: 77 systems in deployment (11 new starts in the quarter) and 56 operational (4 went live); 48 operational at FY2025 year-end. Exol: Atlanta site live with its first customer; Lathrop, CA expected live within 60-90 days of Aug 5, 2026; five buildings referenced.
cost_and_supply_chain_notes: Systems are built by third-party contract manufacturers; Symbotic buys lifts, fixed robots, conveyors and steel racking from vendors and has several single-source suppliers (one supplier exceeded 10% of purchases: $78.6M in Q3 FY26 and $202.7M in 9M FY26). HQ and repair/engineering facility in Wilmington, MA; about 2,000 full-time employees (about 1,950 in the US) at FY2025 year-end. The 10-K says tariffs have already raised some commodity and raw-material costs (e.g., steel) and further tariffs could raise system costs that may not be recoverable. A new storage structure introduced in Aug 2025 shifted project schedules and temporarily reduced revenue. GAAP gross margin trend: FY2025 18.8%; Q1 FY26 21.2%; Q2 22.2%; Q3 22.3% (adjusted: FY2025 21.0%; 23.4%, 24.5%, 25.0%). Revenue is recognized on percentage of completion, so cost estimates drive reported margins.
debt_notes: No funded debt or credit facility borrowings; stockanalysis lists about $26M of total debt (leases/other). Cash and equivalents $1.746B at Jun 27, 2026 (down from $2.009B at Mar 28 on project cash timing; no marketable securities). Cash is partly customer-funded: deferred revenue $1.554B current plus $0.183B noncurrent. Equity raised in Dec 2025: follow-on priced at $55/share; Symbotic sold 8.0M Class A shares (including overallotment) for about $424M net and SoftBank sold 3.5M shares; an omnibus shelf covers up to 48.9M shares plus preferred and debt. Other income $30.6M in Q3 FY26 includes interest and a $19.4M fair-value gain on strategic investments.
customer_concentration: Walmart ('Customer A') was 90.5% of Q3 FY26 revenue (83.8% a year earlier), 87.0% of 9M FY26 revenue, about 85% of FY2025 revenue, and 82.8% of receivables at Jun 27, 2026. UNFI, GreenBox, Southern Glazer's and Albertsons together were about 13% of FY2025 revenue. GreenBox/Exol is a related-party JV with SoftBank; its commercial agreement's initial term expires Jul 23, 2027 (GreenBox may extend two years). SoftBank is also a large shareholder and has been selling (3.5M shares in Dec 2025; 5.59M shares at $50.41 in late May 2026).
key_drivers: Backlog conversion: $22.5B backlog with about 15% (about $3.4B) due within 12 months; 77 systems in deployment vs 56 operational.
Margin expansion: adjusted gross margin 25.0% in Q3 FY26 vs 21.5% a year earlier; adjusted EBITDA $95M (2.1x YoY) with a Q4 guide of $100M-$105M; GAAP operating margin turned positive at 4.6%.
Growth: Q4 FY26 guide implies +23% to +26%; consensus FY2027 revenue $3.60B (+28.5%).

Walmart programs: BreakPack deployed at about half of Walmart's regional DCs; first new-version SymMicro store system being installed (19 older-version systems running); 400-store APD opportunity worth about $5B.
Exol/GreenBox ramp: Atlanta live, Lathrop, CA next; at least $7.5B committed spend.
Diversification: Southern Glazer's second site, Medline, Walmart de Mexico; international 11.6% of Q3 FY26 revenue.
M&A optionality with $1.75B cash: Fox Robotics, ARMS Innovations, cellumation; management says more acquisitions are planned.
Catalyst: Q4 FY2026 report (about Nov 23, 2026, estimated) with commentary on FY2027.
key_risks: Extreme customer concentration: Walmart was 90.5% of Q3 FY26 revenue.

Accounting and controls: material weakness at FY2025 year-end over the timing of cost-of-revenue recognition (which also affects percentage-of-completion revenue), remediation ongoing ($5.8M cost in 9M FY26); the Q3 FY26 10-Q revised prior-period cash flows ($58.2M reclassified from investing to operating, tied to the Walmart ASR deal) and recast prior periods for a stock-compensation accounting change; history of the late-2024 restatement and delayed 10-K, an SEC investigation under Rule 21F-17 disclosed Dec 2024 (stock fell about 35% then), and shareholder law-firm 'investigation' releases in Oct 2026.
Slowing and lumpy growth: LTM revenue growth 20.6% vs 35.7% a year earlier; revenue per deployment reportedly declining; Q3 FY26 free cash flow was -$165M; SymMicro store orders pushed to early 2028.

Valuation and volatility: about 55x forward P/E and 5.9x EV/FY2027E sales, beta about 2.0, stock -44% over 52 weeks and about -34% YTD; post-earnings moves of +39% (Nov 2025), -8% (May 2026) and -15% (Aug 2026).
Thin float and short interest: only about 114M Class A shares float out of about 605M economic shares; 15.5% of float sold short; SoftBank selling.
Dilution: Dec 2025 follow-on and an omnibus shelf for up to 48.9M more shares.
Input costs and suppliers: tariffs on steel and components, single-source suppliers.
Exol/GreenBox commercial agreement initial term ends Jul 23, 2027.

recent_events.event: Agreed to acquire Walmart's Advanced Systems and Robotics business for $200M plus up to $350M contingent; Walmart to pay $520M for a development program and, if criteria are met, buy APD micro-fulfillment systems for 400 stores (more than $5B of potential backlog).
Q3 FY2025 results (after close): revenue $592.1M (+26%) beat, but Q4 guide of $590M-$610M was below about $636M consensus and a new storage structure was flagged as a temporary revenue headwind.

Q4 FY2025 results (after close): FY2025 revenue $2.247B (+26%), Q4 revenue $618.5M, adjusted EBITDA $49.4M, FY2025 FCF $788M, backlog $22.5B, 48 operational systems, first healthcare customer (Medline); Q1 FY26 guide $610M-$630M.
Launched a 10M-share follow-on (priced at $55; company about 6.5M shares plus overallotment, about $424M net; SoftBank 3.5M shares) and an omnibus shelf for up to 48.9M shares.
recent_events.stock_reaction: -17.4% on Dec 4 (73.22 to 60.48); the stock had also fallen 21.5% on Dec 2 (cause not identified in sources); -29% for December

recent_events.event: Q1 FY2026 results (after close): revenue $630M (+29%), GAAP net income $13.4M, adjusted EBITDA $66.9M, FCF $189.5M, cash $1.82B; Q2 guide $650M-$670M revenue and $70M-$75M adjusted EBITDA.
recent_events.stock_reaction: +0.6% on Feb 5 (53.48 to 53.78, volatile intraday), then +11.1% on Feb 6

recent_events.event: Q2 FY2026 results (after close): revenue $676.5M (+23%), adjusted EBITDA $77.8M, FCF $218M, cash $2.0B, 70 systems in deployment; Q3 guide $700M-$720M. Late May: SoftBank sold 5.59M shares at $50.41.
Announced acquisition of ARMS Innovations (UK warehouse operations software); the Fox Robotics dock-automation acquisition also closed around Q3 FY26 (exact date not retrieved).

Q3 FY2026 results (after close): revenue $720.8M (+22%) beat about $715M, but EPS $0.09 missed about $0.13; backlog slipped to $22.5B from $22.7B; adjusted EBITDA $95M; Q4 guide $760M-$780M; Walmart store-order (SymMicro) impact not expected until early 2028; Q3 FCF -$165M.
Announced acquisition of cellumation (Bremen, Germany; celluveyor software-driven sortation; 70+ employees; terms not disclosed), expanding its European presence.
recent_events.stock_reaction: +0.3% on Oct 13; -7.3% on Oct 14 as a law-firm 'investigation' release circulated

recent_events.event: Stock closed at $37.90, near its 52-week low of $36.47, after price-target cuts (Barclays $38 Underweight in Sep; Needham $60; TD Cowen $70 on about Oct 23).
recent_events.stock_reaction: -3.5% on the day; about -10% for October to date

notes: Share count and market cap use all economic shares: Class A 129.87M + Class V-1 71.37M + Class V-3 403.56M as of Aug 3, 2026 (Class V are non-traded legacy interests exchangeable into Class A). Yahoo shows a market cap of only about $7.1B because it counts Class A shares only. total_debt_bn 0 means no borrowings. cash_burn_annual_bn is 0 because LTM and FY2025 free cash flow were positive (Q3 FY26 alone was -$165M). LTM operating income ($14M) is from stockanalysis; prior periods were recast for an accounting-principle change, so a hand calculation gives about $24M. FY2025 figures are as originally reported (net loss of $91.0M is consolidated, including noncontrolling interests); later filings revised some FY2025 quarters. ev_ebitda_forward 43.6x is an ESTIMATE: EV $21.2B divided by an assumed FY2027 adjusted EBITDA of about $0.49B (13.5% margin on $3.60B consensus revenue, vs 13.2% in Q3 FY26); no FY2027 EBITDA consensus was found. Short interest 15.5% of float is from stockanalysis (17.69M shares vs a 114.04M float); Yahoo shows 31.8% of float as of Sep 30, 2026, which conflicts with its own 13.6% of shares outstanding. Geographic and revenue-type mix are Q3 FY26; for 9M FY26 the US was 92.3% and international 7.7%. The 2025 restatement/SEC investigation details come from a Dec 2024 short-seller (Hunterbrook, disclosed short) article plus the FY2025 10-K. Not retrieved because the search budget and hourly fetch limit ran out: the Fox Robotics close date, the cause of the Dec 2, 2025 drop, cellumation deal terms, and the current status of the SEC matter.
